Dear Siam Riverside International Hospital,

I am writing as CarryPay, on behalf of the family of your patient Tariq Mahmood, who was admitted this morning with chest pain. We are assisting the family with arranging payment for his treatment.

Could you please send us, at your earliest convenience:

1. An estimate or fee statement for the planned treatment, including any deposit required and the deadline for payment.
2. Your bank account details on official hospital letterhead (account name, account number, SWIFT/BIC, bank name) so we can arrange an international bank transfer.
3. The patient hospital number (HN) and any other reference your bank requires to correctly allocate payments.

We will arrange payment promptly once we receive these details.

Thank you for your help.

Kind regards,
CarryPay, on behalf of the family of Tariq Mahmood
